origin: cwe/89/csharp Remediation Steps: EF Core FromSqlRaw is unsafe when values are interpolated into the SQL string before execution

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: A controller query parameter flows into an interpolated EF Core SQL string that is executed with FromSqlRaw().

trap: Changing only the call name while still building sql with interpolation, or passing term as an extra FromSqlRaw argument without adding placeholders. A correct fix should use LINQ, FromSqlInterpolated, or FromSqlRaw with placeholders and separate arguments for every user-controlled value.
must_preserve: The search still filters by tenant and by a contains-style product name term, returns Product rows asynchronously, and does not turn an empty term into a different tenant-wide authorization behavior.
